Application Data.NAME: Sunny Days Variety Store
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunny Days Variety Store is a retail establishment specializing in a diverse range of consumer goods, including household items, apparel, toys, seasonal products, and small electronics. We cater to the local community through our physical storefront and maintain an online presence for convenience. Our operations prioritize strong inventory management and loss prevention measures to mitigate theft and spoilage. We emphasize customer service and compliance with safety regulations to ensure a pleasant shopping experience for our clientele. Annual sales are projected to be under $500,000, with minimal online sales exposure.

Application Data.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Sunny Days Variety Store does not own or operate any other businesses.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 05/15/2023, a water damage incident occurred due to a burst pipe in the storage area, leading to damages estimated at $1,500. The claim was filed and is currently pending review with the insurer. Additionally, on 08/10/2023, there was a theft incident where merchandise valued at $1,000 was stolen. This claim has been resolved, and the amount recovered through the insurance process is reflected in the total losses.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 1 Safe, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security patrols during business hours and video surveillance systems installed throughout the store to deter theft and ensure safety for both customers and employees.
